HealFlow

An offline-first personal health record for your phone.

In development

HealFlow is an offline-first personal health record for Android and iOS. It lets you log health measurements such as blood pressure, weight, blood sugar, heart rate, temperature, and height, record symptoms and medications, and attach documents like lab reports, prescriptions, scans, and vaccination records. There is no login or account system, so you can start using it right away, and every record stays on your device unless you choose to back it up or share it yourself. See the Privacy Policy for details on how your data is stored and handled.

Features

Health Records

Log blood pressure, weight, blood sugar, heart rate, temperature, and height entries over time.

Symptoms

Record symptoms along with their severity and duration.

Medications

Save the medications you take regularly, including dose and frequency, so logging them is quick.

Documents

Attach and organize lab reports, prescriptions, scans, vaccination records, and other health documents.

Profile

Store basic profile details, such as date of birth, gender, height, and blood group, used across your records.

Timeline and Reports

Review your entries over time from a timeline view and reports.

Local Backup and Restore

Create a single backup file of everything on this device and restore it later, with no cloud account required.

App Lock

Protect the app with an optional PIN and biometric unlock.

Delete All Data

A dedicated action to permanently erase everything HealFlow has stored on this device, in one step.
